differences: A river runs across the middle of the board. The elephants may never cross it, and a soldier may step sideways only once it has crossed it.
Each side has a palace: the nine squares on the middle three files of its back three ranks. The general and its two advisors may never leave it.
Under the flying general rule, the two generals may never face each other on an open file, with nothing between them. So a piece standing alone between them may not leave their file.
Red traditionally moves first in Xiangqi, against Black. This app calls Red White, as in chess.
